exposure: Opioid use within 24 hours prior to discharge
outcome: Detectable record of filling an outpatient postpartum opioid prescription in the Illinois prescription monitoring program (PMP)
cohort: 344 women who underwent cesarean delivery and used opioids within 24 hours prior to discharge
finding: Nearly half of women who underwent a cesarean delivery and used opioids shortly before discharge did not have a detectable postpartum opioid prescription in the PMP, highlighting limitations in the accuracy of PMPs for tracking postpartum opioid use.
